questions.q: The following sentence has been divided into parts. One of them contains an error. Select the part that contains the error from the given options.
o: are grandest than
The Dussehra celebrations
any other part
questions.s:
Correct Answer: are grandest than

Solution:
The phrase "are grandest than" is grammatically incorrect. The word "grandest" is the superlative form and should be used with "the", not with "than".
When making a comparison between two or more things, we use the comparative form (grander) with "than", not the superlative.

Correct form: "are grander than"

✅ Correct sentence: The Dussehra celebrations in Mysore this year are grander than in any other part of the state.

Meanings:
grandest – the most magnificent – सबसे भव्य
grander – more magnificent (comparison) – अधिक भव्य
celebrations – events to mark an occasion – उत्सव
state – a region within a country – राज्य

questions.q:
The wedding gown / looked decently / despite being / studded wit jewels.

{CGL PRE 09/12/2022 S3}
questions.s: The adverb "decently" is incorrectly used in the sentence. The correct adjective to describe how the wedding gown looked should be "decent," not "decently." "Decently" is an adverb that modifies verbs, not adjectives. In this case, we need an adjective to describe the noun "gown.”

questions.q: She runs (a) / more faster (b) / than her brother. (c) / No error (d)
questions.s: The error is in part (b). 'Faster' is already comparative; 'more' is redundant. Correct form is 'faster.' Answer: (b). 'Faster' pehle se comparative hai, 'more' extra hai. Sahi form hai 'faster.' Jawab: (b).

questions.q: This is (a) / a most difficult (b) / problem to solve. (c) / No error (d)
questions.s: The error is in part (b). 'Most difficult' should be 'very difficult' as 'most' is superlative, not needed here. Answer: (b). 'Most difficult' ke bajay 'very difficult' sahi hai kyunki 'most' superlative hai. Jawab: (b).

questions.q: The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.
o: in the price of petroleum products
household budgets severely
The recently hike
questions.s:
Explanation:

The phrase “The recently hike” is grammatically incorrect.

  • “Recently” is an adverb, but it is incorrectly placed before the noun “hike.”

  • What’s needed is an adjective form to describe the noun “hike.”

  • The correct form is: “recent hike” — where “recent” is the adjective.

Part of Speech with the Error:

Adjective/Adverb usage — “recently” (adverb) used in place of “recent” (adjective).

✔️ Correct Sentence:

The recent hike in the price of petroleum products will hit household budgets severely.

✅ Therefore, the segment with the grammatical error is: The recently hike.
